title: Pay a supplier after approval
summary: Enter a supplier invoice, get it approved, then pay it by Paystack transfer and text the owner the result.
description: Start it with the supplier's name, Paystack transfer recipient code, the amount in naira and the invoice number. Someone with the approver role approves or rejects it; only an approved invoice is paid, once (the invoice number is the payment's idempotency key, so a retry never pays twice). The owner gets a text with the outcome; the owner's phone number is the tenant variable owner_phone.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: approver_role
params.title: Who approves
params.description: The role that approves supplier payments.

params.name: max_amount
params.title: Largest payment (naira)
params.description: Invoices above this are refused when entered.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The Paystack account suppliers are paid from.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

steps.name: Pay the supplier by Paystack transfer
Text the owner that the supplier was paid

input.sms: ='Paystack transfer for invoice ' + trigger.body.invoice_number + ' to ' + trigger.body.supplier + ' (NGN ' + string(trigger.body.amount_naira) + '): ' + steps.pay_supplier.output.status

steps.name: Text the owner that nothing was paid

input.sms: ='Invoice ' + trigger.body.invoice_number + ' from ' + trigger.body.supplier + ' was not approved; nothing was paid.'
